How do I book a car?: How do I book a car?
You can book a car by selecting your des: You can book a car by selecting your desired vehicle, choosing pickup/drop-off dates and locations, and completing the payment. Our booking process is quick and secure.
Can I modify or cancel my booking?: Can I modify or cancel my booking?
Yes, you can modify or cancel your booki: Yes, you can modify or cancel your booking up to 24 hours before pickup. Cancellation fees may apply depending on how close to the pickup date you cancel.
What is included in the rental price?: What is included in the rental price?
The rental price includes basic insuranc: The rental price includes basic insurance, unlimited mileage, 24/7 roadside assistance, and vehicle maintenance. Additional insurance and GPS can be added for extra cost.

What documents do I need to rent a car?: What documents do I need to rent a car?
You need a valid driver's license (held: You need a valid driver's license (held for at least 1 year), a valid ID or passport, and a credit card in the driver’s name for the security deposit.
What is the minimum age to rent a car?: What is the minimum age to rent a car?
The minimum age is 21 years old. Drivers: The minimum age is 21 years old. Drivers under 25 may be subject to a young driver surcharge. Some luxury and specialty vehicles require drivers to be 25 or older.
We offer basic coverage (included), coll: We offer basic coverage (included), collision damage waiver (CDW), theft protection, and personal accident insurance. You can customize your coverage during booking.
Where can I pick up and return the car?: Where can I pick up and return the car?
You can pick up and return cars at any o: You can pick up and return cars at any of our locations including airports, city centers, and partner locations. Different location returns are available for an additional fee.
What if I return the car late?: What if I return the car late?
A grace period of 29 minutes is allowed. After that, late fees apply. If you know you’ll be late, contact us immediately to extend your rental and avoid additional charges.
What should I do in case of an accident?: What should I do in case of an accident?
First, ensure everyone’s safety and call: First, ensure everyone’s safety and call emergency services if needed. Then contact our 24/7 hotline immediately. Document the scene with photos and exchange information with other parties involved.
Can I drive the car abroad or to other r: Can I drive the car abroad or to other regions?
Cross-border travel requires prior appro: Cross-border travel requires prior approval and additional documentation. Some regions may have restrictions. Please inform us during booking if you plan to travel outside the rental area.
